title: Deaith Emmersity
description: A Mod That Adds a story and adventure like things to the game without changing the core of the game
body:
This Mod Adds New blocks. items. and weapons to your game to give it an emmersive and adventurus feel, along with a few structures. if you are looking for somthing new and interesting, This Is It! 

To be more clear
it adds New blocks along with New variants of Current blocks and Decor like "pebbles" and "Obsidian Piller" to give it more of an immersive feel to the game!

This mod is in beta and is not done and is a very small mod!
 More Things are to be added and or changed. if you have any bug reports please report them to me in the discord. the link you can find on this page.

Thank you!
